db:select.doc:name: Validate Client Credentials
db:select.db:sql: SELECT client_id, client_secret, user_id FROM api_clients WHERE client_id = :clientId AND client_secret = :clientSecret

logger.message: About to store in DB - clientId: #[vars.clientId], callbackUrl: #[vars.callbackUrl], accessToken: #[vars.accessToken]
logger.doc:name: Log DB insert params

db:insert.doc:name: Store Token in DB
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO api_clients (client_id, client_secret, access_token, expires_at, callback_url) VALUES (:clientId, :clientSecret, :accessToken, :expiresAt, :callbackUrl) ON CONFLICT (client_id) DO UPDATE SET access_token = :accessToken, expires_at = :expiresAt, callback_url = :callbackUrl
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ clientId: vars.clientId, clientSecret: vars.clientSecret, accessToken: vars.accessToken, expiresAt: vars.expirationTime, callbackUrl: vars.callbackUrl }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "token": vars.accessToken, "userId": vars.clientId }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { access_token: vars.accessToken, token_type: vars.tokenType, expires_in: vars.expiresIn, scope: "read write" }

logger.message: Database connectivity error during OAuth validation: #[error.description]
logger.doc:name: Log DB connectivity error

set-payload.value: {"error": "server_error", "error_description": "An error occurred while processing the token request"}
set-payload.doc:name: Set server error payload

when.expression: #[attributes != null and attributes.headers != null and attributes.headers.'authorization' != null and (attributes.headers.'authorization' startsWith 'Bearer ')]

db:select.doc:name: Retrieve Token from DB
db:select.db:sql: SELECT access_token, expires_at, client_id FROM api_clients WHERE access_token = :token AND expires_at > :currentTime
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{token: vars.bearerToken, currentTime: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"}}]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- {message: "Bad request"}
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- {message: "Resource not found"}
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- {message: "Method not allowed"}
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- {message: "Not acceptable"}
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- {message: "Unsupported media type"}
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- {message: "Not implemented"}
%dw 2.0 input payload application/json output application/java --- payload

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: #[if (vars.password != null and vars.password != "") java!java::util::Base64::getEncoder().encodeToString((vars.password ++ "salt") as Binary) else ""]

when.expression: #[vars.username == null or vars.username == '' or vars.password == null or vars.password == '' or vars.email == null or vars.email == '']

logger.message: Missing required fields - username: #[vars.username], password: #[if(vars.password == null or vars.password == '') 'MISSING' else 'PROVIDED'], email: #[vars.email]
logger.doc:name: Log missing fields

db:select.doc:name: Check User Exists
db:select.db:sql: SELECT username, email FROM users WHERE username = :username OR email = :email

db:insert.doc:name: Insert New User
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO users (username, email, first_name, last_name, password_hash) VALUES (:username, :email, :firstName, :lastName, :passwordHash)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ username: vars.username, email: vars.email, firstName: vars.firstName, lastName: vars.lastName, passwordHash: vars.passwordHash }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 input payload application/json output application/java --- payload

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: #[if (vars.password != null and vars.password != "") java!java::util::Base64::getEncoder().encodeToString((vars.password ++ "salt") as Binary) else ""]

set-payload.value: {"error": "invalid_request", "error_description": "Missing required fields: username, password, and clientId"}
set-payload.doc:name: Set validation error

db:select.doc:name: Validate User Credentials
db:select.db:sql: SELECT user_id, username, email, first_name, last_name FROM users WHERE username = :username AND password_hash = :passwordHash AND is_active = true

db:select.doc:name: Check Existing API Client
db:select.db:sql: SELECT client_id, client_secret FROM api_clients WHERE user_id = :userId

logger.message: Login - About to create new API client - clientId: #[vars.clientId], userId: #[vars.userId], salesforceUserId: #[vars.salesforceUserId]
logger.doc:name: Log new client params

db:insert.doc:name: Create API Client
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO api_clients (client_id, client_secret, user_id, salesforce_user_id, is_active) VALUES (:clientId, :clientSecret, :userId, :salesforceUserId, true)

logger.message: Login - New API client created successfully
logger.doc:name: Log new client success

logger.message: Login - About to update DB - clientId: #[vars.clientId], salesforceUserId: #[vars.salesforceUserId], accessToken: #[vars.accessToken]
logger.doc:name: Log DB update params

db:update.doc:name: Update Token in DB
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE api_clients SET access_token = :accessToken, expires_at = :expiresAt, token_expires_at = :tokenExpiresAt, refresh_token = :refreshToken, refresh_token_expires_at = :refreshExpiresAt, salesforce_user_id = :salesforceUserId, is_active = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE client_id = :clientId
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ clientId: vars.clientId, accessToken: vars.accessToken, expiresAt: vars.tokenExpirationTime, tokenExpiresAt: vars.tokenExpirationTime, refreshToken: vars.refreshToken, refreshExpiresAt: vars.refreshExpirationTime, salesforceUserId: vars.salesforceUserId }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { access_token: vars.accessToken, refresh_token: vars.refreshToken, token_type: vars.tokenType, expires_in: vars.expiresIn, user_id: vars.salesforceUserId, client_id: vars.clientId, scope: "read write" }
%dw 2.0 input payload application/json output application/java --- payload

db:select.doc:name: Validate Refresh Token
db:select.db:sql: SELECT client_id, access_token, refresh_token, refresh_token_expires_at, salesforce_user_id, is_active FROM api_clients WHERE refresh_token = :refreshToken AND refresh_token_expires_at > :currentTime AND is_active = true
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{refreshToken: vars.refreshToken, currentTime: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"}}]

db:update.doc:name: Update Tokens
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE api_clients SET access_token = :newAccessToken, expires_at = :tokenExpiresAt, token_expires_at = :tokenExpiresAt, refresh_token = :newRefreshToken, refresh_token_expires_at = :refreshExpiresAt, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE client_id = :clientId
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ clientId: vars.clientId, newAccessToken: vars.newAccessToken, tokenExpiresAt: vars.tokenExpirationTime, newRefreshToken: vars.newRefreshToken, refreshExpiresAt: vars.refreshExpirationTime }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { access_token: vars.newAccessToken, refresh_token: vars.newRefreshToken, token_type: vars.tokenType, expires_in: vars.expiresIn }
%dw 2.0 input payload application/json output application/java --- payload
